Hi Marissa -

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Helpful overview. A quick recap and some procurement questions from our side so we can map next steps with legal/finance: 

1) Pricing & contract: Do you support a standard one-year term with a PO and net-45 payment terms? Any minimums we should be aware of?

2) Security/compliance: Can you share your SOC 2 Type II summary and the standard security questionnaire answers? Our security team will want the evidence URL or a package.

3) Vendor onboarding: What does your vendor onboarding process look like (contact for invoicing, tax forms, W9, PO acceptance)?

4) Timeline: We’re targeting a pilot by mid-May. What lead time do you need for provisioning and integration support?

If you can loop in whoever owns procurement/finance for Redwood, that would be great. Happy to schedule a short call if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Kim
Head of Procurement
Aurora Payments

Hi Sophie -

Thanks for the clear list - I’ve looped in Rishi (Sales Ops / pricing lead) and Dev (Customer Success / onboarding) to help answer procurement/security questions and confirm timeline. Quick answers inline, more details below: 

1) Pricing & contract: We support PO-based invoicing and normally do net-30 by default, but net-45 is possible for enterprise deals. We have monthly usage billing; we can structure an annual commitment if you prefer a discount. No hard minimums for pilot-level usage. Deal id RDW-7541 for internal tracking.

2) Security/compliance: Attaching our SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a link to our security pack in Drive. If Aurora needs the full report we can arrange an NDA and secure transfer.

3) Vendor onboarding: Typical steps - collect W9 (US), PO to accept, contact for invoices (billing@redwood.com), set up billing contact in your system. We can accept PO via email; Dev can confirm acceptance cadence.

4) Timeline: For a pilot we can provision hosted API access within 3 business days once contract/PO is received. If you want a dedicated environment or private deployment, that takes longer (2-4 weeks depending on networking).

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi: will send a high-level commercial term sheet and PO template.
- Dev: will schedule a 30-min onboarding handoff call next week to walk integration and invoicing.

Thanks - happy to jump on a call if useful.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
